summary: Fixed verified question defects and lost panel history; added policy-aware creation, local menu subset, status navigation, local pin/copy, UTF-8 CAS editor and replacement-handshake consumers. Qualified core rendered live workflow, 233-event real history and a scoped custom environment. Remaining development work is distinguished from platform, consent and fixture limitations.
